definition: Impossible to explain or understand through ordinary reasoning.
book: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
quote: “But I have gone too far in the way of inexplicable services to pause before I see the end.”
example_sentence: The printer jams for reasons that remain inexplicable.
